latest_release.name: v6.0.0
latest_release.body:
Please refer to [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/alex8088/electron-vite/blob/v6.0.0/CHANGELOG.md) for details.

# electron-vite 6.0 Is Out: Vite 8 Support and a Smoother Electron Development Experience

electron-vite 6.0 brings Vite 8 support alongside improvements to build efficiency, bytecode compilation, and development reliability.

## Highlights

- **Vite 8 support**: Integrates with Rolldown and supports both `rollupOptions` and `rolldownOptions`, while retaining compatibility with Vite 6 and 7.
- **Improved bytecode compilation**: Uses a single compiler session to process all code, compiles through Electron processes. The `chunkAlias` option now supports regular expressions.
- **Less build overhead**: Loads Babel only when needed.
- **A smoother development workflow**: Improves Electron process shutdown and signal handling, with fixes for asset paths, caching, and multi-entry builds.

## Upgrade

Once the stable release is available, upgrade with:

```bash
npm install -D electron-vite@6
```

Thank you to everyone who contributed code, reported issues, and shared feedback. Follow the project on [GitHub](https://github.com/alex8088/electron-vite) and get ready for 6.0!
